NotchShot A small app for your Mac

A little context.
From any app.

Capture the window, its text, and the controls that give it context. Keep it all in a tiny shelf in your notch, ready to copy into your next conversation.

Early preview · Apple silicon · macOS 15+ · 9 MB

More than a screenshot.

Keep the image, readable text, and the app’s accessibility tree together.

A shortcut to context.

Press left Shift + right Shift to capture. Select a few shots and copy them in one go.

Right here on your Mac.

Capture and text recognition run locally. You choose what to copy or export.

A little heads-up. This is an early development build and isn’t notarized by Apple yet, so macOS may block it from opening. Capture needs Accessibility and Screen Recording permissions. What’s captured and pasted can vary by app.
